# Clear-ZbxHistory

## SYNOPSIS

Deletes the history and trends of items.

## SYNTAX

```
Clear-ZbxHistory [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixItem>[]> [-Force] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Clear-ZbxHistory cmdlet deletes every value the server stored for the items given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped items), their history and their trends, with history.clear. The items themselves stay and keep collecting. It is the heaviest delete the server runs, so the command asks twice for each item unless -Force is given, and -WhatIf lists the items it would clear. It writes nothing.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Clear the history of one item

```powershell
Get-ZbxItem -Host 'web-01' -Name 'Requests' | Clear-ZbxHistory -Force
```

-Force answers both questions; the item keeps collecting new values.

### Example 2: Preview clearing the history of a host's items

```powershell
Get-ZbxItem -Host 'web-01' | Clear-ZbxHistory -WhatIf
```

-WhatIf names each item the command would clear, and deletes nothing.
